title: Engagement Manifest
description: Persistent per-engagement authorization + scope + progress state for the hunting ecosystem. Established ONCE per engagement and reused on resume. Never stores raw credentials, cookies, API secrets, or other sensitive authentication material.

engagement_id.description: Stable slug identifying this engagement (derived from the program id). A new or materially changed scope gets its own engagement_id; authorization is never carried across engagements.

id.description: Program identifier, e.g. 'hackerone:acme', 'intigriti:acme', or a user-supplied label.

platform.description: hackerone | intigriti | bugcrowd | private | self | lab-ctf

scope_source.description: Where the scope/authorization came from: a program URL, a local file path, or an explicit user statement. Provenance, not a secret.

researcher_tag.description: Non-secret researcher identifier used in required headers (e.g. the X-Intigriti username or H1 handle). NOT a token/cookie.

established.description: True once the one-time authorization gate has passed for this engagement. When true, routine authorized research proceeds without re-asking.

established_at.description: UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) when the gate passed.

exclusions.description: Explicitly out-of-scope patterns; enforced even when a matching URL appears in recon output.

rate_limit_rps.description: Max requests/second permitted by program rules. Null => conservative default (<=5 rps).

required_headers.description: Non-secret headers the program requires on every request (e.g. {"X-Intigriti":"<tag>"}). Never stores auth tokens.

testing_restrictions.description: Program prohibitions/restrictions: forbidden endpoints, no-automated-scanning, no-DoS, payment-flow rules, known-issues/dupes, etc.

status.description: none=not started; running=a job is in progress (do not launch a duplicate); complete=fresh recon.sh finished; imported=an existing recon directory was ingested; stale/failed per logs.

engine.description: Which engine produced the active recon dir. recon.sh is the standard active engine; recon.py is the passive layer; imported=user-supplied directory.

recon_dir.description: Path to the recon output directory (fresh or supplied).

inventory.description: Path to the deduped master URL inventory (inventory.jsonl).

excluded_inventory.description: Path to the separate out-of-scope inventory; these URLs are never scheduled for testing.

tool_status.description: Per-tool run outcome parsed from recon logs/run_config: ok | failed | skipped | missing. A failed/skipped tool is missing evidence, never reported as coverage.

phase.description: Current workflow phase. On resume, continue from the next incomplete phase rather than restarting.

completed_work.description: Timestamped record of finished phases/batches so a resumed session does not repeat completed checks.
